name: LTV-300
summary: The LTV-300 is the free RallyDrop vehicle and a light transport option.
role: Use it for early movement, quick regrouping, and basic team transport when you do not need mounted weapons.
fun_facts: The LTV-300 is the only RallyDrop vehicle exposed to free access.

name: MBT-800
summary: The MBT-800 is a heavy RallyDrop tank with high health and multiple weapons.
role: Use the MBT-800 when the team needs armored firepower more than speed. It is slow, but it brings the heaviest RallyDrop health pool outside the other 1000-health armor.
fun_facts: The MBT-800 has four vehicle weapons.

name: MH-60 Blackhawk
summary: The MH-60 Blackhawk is a RallyDrop aircraft for moving a squad quickly across the battlefield.
role: Use it when distance is the problem. It carries a large group but has low vehicle health, so landing zones and pilot control matter.
fun_facts: The Blackhawk carries a large squad but has a much smaller health pool than armored RallyDrop vehicles.

name: MH-60 Blackhawk (Pilot Minigun)
summary: This MH-60 Blackhawk variant adds a pilot minigun to the transport helicopter.
role: Use it when the pilot needs offensive pressure while transporting the team. It keeps the same low aircraft health profile as the standard Blackhawk.
fun_facts: The pilot-minigun variant gives the pilot a weapon while keeping the Blackhawk transport role.

name: MIB831 Mastiff
summary: The MIB831 Mastiff is a heavily armored RallyDrop vehicle with a mounted weapon.
role: Use the Mastiff for protected movement and sustained ground support. It has the highest RallyDrop health among the listed vehicles.
fun_facts: The Mastiff's health value is higher than the MBT-800's.

name: MTG-92
summary: The MTG-92 is a light armed RallyDrop vehicle.
role: Use it as a mobile gun platform when you need speed and a weapon but cannot commit to heavier armor.
fun_facts: The MTG-92, MTP-92, and MTV-92 all sit in the same light RallyDrop family but differ in speed, seating, and mounted weapons.

name: MTP-92
summary: The MTP-92 is a light RallyDrop vehicle with one mounted weapon.
role: Use it for quick armed movement where a heavier vehicle would arrive too late.
fun_facts: The MTP-92's forward speed is slightly higher than the MTG-92's.

name: MTV-92
summary: The MTV-92 is the fastest member of the MT-92 RallyDrop group.
role: Use it when speed matters more than staying power. It has a low health pool, so do not treat it as armor.
fun_facts: The MTV-92 has the highest forward speed of the MT-92 trio.

name: PA Humvee (MG)
summary: The PA Humvee (MG) is a RallyDrop armed transport with a machine gun.
role: Use it to move a small group while keeping a gun active for street pressure.
fun_facts: The Humvee MG is faster than both JLTV variants in forward speed.

name: PA JLTV (Cannon)
summary: The PA JLTV (Cannon) is a RallyDrop JLTV variant with a cannon weapon.
role: Use the cannon JLTV when the team needs a tougher armed vehicle and burstier vehicle fire than the machine-gun version.
fun_facts: Both JLTV variants share the same health value.

name: PA JLTV (MG)
summary: The PA JLTV (MG) is the machine-gun RallyDrop JLTV variant.
role: Use it for tougher small-team transport when you still want a mounted gun covering the street.
fun_facts: The machine-gun JLTV is a little faster than the cannon JLTV in forward speed.

name: PA467 Centurion
summary: The PA467 Centurion is a heavy RallyDrop vehicle with three weapons and a 1000-health pool.
role: Use the Centurion when the team needs heavy support but still wants more road speed than the MBT-800.
fun_facts: The Centurion has the same health value as the MBT-800 but a higher forward speed.

name: Panzer IV
summary: The Panzer IV is a WWII RallyDrop tank available through the WWII vehicle pass.
role: Use it as a WWII-pass heavy armor option. It has four operator seats, four weapons, and a 500-health pool.
fun_facts: The Panzer IV appears in-game as Panzer IV Ausf. G.

name: T-34
summary: The T-34 is a WWII RallyDrop tank available through the WWII vehicle pass.
role: Use it as an alternate WWII-pass tank with three weapons, four operator seats, and a similar health profile to the Panzer IV.
fun_facts: The T-34 appears in-game as T-34-76.
